title: Student App and Journey Integration
problemSolved: Students navigate a fragmented digital estate with no single useful place to start their day, and King’s does not yet have a coherent student-facing product and reusable app platform through which essential information, services and deeper digital journeys can be brought together.
whatChanges: King’s establishes the first version of the Digital Student Experience Hub as a common digital starting point for students. From September 2027, a shared home brings together the substantive King’s Edge experience with deliberately light-touch access to timetabling, KEATS and Ask King’s, using existing feeds, widgets, authenticated hand-offs or deep links where appropriate. The common shell and app foundations then provide a route to deeper integrated journeys over time.
